Ecosystem Partnerships

Livelihood Strengthening

  • Research on livelihood profiles in each state in partnership with XISS, ILRT, SeSTA, Samahiya Math, VAF and Praxis.
  • Partnered with BAIF for a scoping study in Madhya Pradesh.

Quality of Implementation / Layering

  • Raising The Village for the whole-village model being implemented in Odisha.
  • A pilot layering Natural Resource Management onto the graduation approach is in progress, borrowing from FES and WOTR's experience for training.
  • Wild-human conflict training from Aranyak; PwD-focused training in Meghalaya from Sol's Arc; CINI in Jharkhand on health, gender and nutrition; PRADAN in West Bengal supporting NTFP value-chain linkage.
  • Manipal Foundation is plugged into the PJAA project for health-focused interventions with programme participants.

Convenings and Ecosystem Gatherings

  • Webinar on gender-intentional design under Samaveshi Aajeevika Yojana held at NRLM.
  • National dissemination of learnings from UPAJ held at NRLM.
